jobs.title: Sales Operations Engineer Entry-level Full-time
jobs.description: Directeam ALL JOBS Sales Operations Engineer Engineering Entry-level Full-time Description Directeam empowers startups to scale AWS efficiently through our premier FinOps ecosystem. We combine our flagship automated savings engine, Sombrero Savings, with our latest breakthrough: a Real-Time AI FinOps Agent. As a top-tier AI-Native AWS Partner, we don’t just manage costs, we provide a strategic advantage that converts cloud waste into business runway. Our innovation is delivering massive market impact. Our AI-backed service has already been adopted by our client base, delivering an average monthly cost reduction of over 30%. This innovation uniquely positions us as the dominant cloud optimization partner. We're looking for a Sales Operations Engineer to bridge customer success and cloud engineering. You'll own the operational backbone of customer onboarding and ongoing AWS account management executing structured, repeatable processes while growing your technical depth in cloud architecture, security, and optimization. This is a unique hybrid role: part operational excellence, part hands-on cloud engineering, all mentored by senior engineers. Why This Role Matters As a partner-side engineer, you'll directly shape how customers experience AWS. Every onboarding checklist you refine, every cost optimization you implement, and every security baseline you enforce directly impacts customer success and Directeam's reputation. You'll own end-to-end customer journeys and grow into a well-rounded cloud engineer. What You'll Do Customer Onboarding & Offboarding Onboard new customers onto AWS - set up secure, multi-account landing zones, account structure, guardrails, and baselines, mentored by senior engineers. Build and refine onboarding checklists, runbooks, and configuration playbooks to make the process repeatable and predictable. Off board customers cleanly and safely - decommission accounts and resources with the right controls, data migration, and handover documentation. AWS Security & Compliance Apply security best practices across customer environments: IAM policies, guardrails, security baselines, and monitoring aligned to the AWS Well-Architected Framework. Work with customers to implement Security Hub, GuardDuty, and config controls; validate compliance with customer requirements. Operational Support Provide day-to-day support across customer AWS environments - monitoring, troubleshooting, and keeping systems healthy. Respond to alerts, investigate infrastructure issues, and escalate appropriately. Maintain visibility into customer account health and proactively surface risks (unused resources, security drift, cost anomalies). Documentation & Process Improvement Keep onboarding checklists, runbooks, and configuration documentation clear, current, and repeatable. Document lessons learned and improve processes after each customer engagement. Collaborate with the team to standardize best practices and automation. Collaboration Work closely with senior cloud engineers, solutions architects, and customers. Participate in customer calls and technical discussions, learn from senior team members. Contribute to knowledge-sharing sessions and team retrospectives. Requirements Must-Have Takes Ownership - Sees tasks through end-to-end, cares about doing them right, and takes pride in customer outcomes. Highly Organized - Comfortable running structured, checklist-driven processes; thrives in a detail-oriented environment. Eager to Learn - Genuinely wants to go deeper into the AWS stack, security, FinOps, cloud architecture, and DevOps. Foundational AWS & Cloud Knowledge - Understanding of AWS core services (EC2, S3, IAM, VPC) and cloud concepts. Problem-Solving & Communication - Strong analytical skills and clear, direct communication (written and verbal). Language Fluency - Hebrew fluent (written and spoken), English high-level (written and spoken). Education & Experience - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. Nice-to-Have Cost Tooling - Exposure to Umbrella cost, understanding of cloud cost management practices. AWS Landing Zones - Hands-on experience with Landing Zone Accelerator (LZA), AWS Organizations, or Control Tower. AWS Security - Familiarity with IAM best practices, Security Hub, GuardDuty, Config, or KMS. Infrastructure as Code - Experience with Terraform, CloudFormation, or AWS CDK. CI/CD & DevOps - Exposure to GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar; Docker and Kubernetes (EKS) knowledge. AI & ML on AWS - Curiosity about or hands-on exposure to generative AI on AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker) or Anthropic's Claude API. A real differentiator on our team. AWS Certifications - AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, Solutions Architect – Associate, or similar. Our office is located at Beit Gibor Sport Tower, Ramat Gan, near Tel Aviv Savidor Central railway station. APPLY FOR THIS JOB ALL JOBS

jobs.title: Head of Operations Ramat Gan Management Full-time
jobs.description: Directeam ALL JOBS Head of Operations Management Ramat Gan Management Full-time Description Directeam empowers startups to scale their AWS infrastructure efficiently through our premier FinOps ecosystem. We combine our flagship automated savings engine, Sombrero Savings, with our latest innovation: a real-time, AI-powered FinOps, SRE, and cloud architecture platform designed to help engineering teams analyze, investigate, and optimize their AWS environments. As a premier AI-native AWS Partner, we go beyond simple cost management. We provide a strategic advantage that converts cloud inefficiency into business runway. Our solutions deliver significant market impact. Our AI-driven services have been widely adopted across our client base, achieving an average monthly cost reduction of over 30% and positioning us as a leader in cloud optimization. The Head of Operations serves as the CEO’s primary execution partner. This role is responsible for transforming company strategy into measurable execution, ensuring accountability across departments, and building the operating system that enables scale. The role owns company-wide execution, strategic initiatives, operational excellence, and cross-functional alignment. Requirements Build & Manage the Operating System: Design and scale the company’s operational framework to support rapid organizational maturity. Drive Strategic Execution & Alignment: Turn high-level strategy into flawless execution while building cross-functional accountability across departments. Embed AI-Driven Efficiency: Champion an AI-first internal culture, integrating advanced AI tools and automated workflows to eliminate manual operational overhead. Own Metric Frameworks: Design and institutionalize company-wide KPI and OKR systems to drive data-backed decision-making. Provide Executive Leverage: Establish rigorous reporting protocols and business reviews to optimize executive bandwidth. Lead Special Initiatives: Spearhead high-stakes, cross-functional projects directly alongside the CEO. What We’re Looking For 7+ years in Operations, Strategy, Consulting, or Business Leadership; 3+ years leading high-impact, cross-functional initiatives. Proven track record working directly with Founders/CEOs as a trusted execution partner. Demonstrated success scaling organizations and building lean processes from the ground up. Practical experience identifying and integrating generative AI platforms and automation tools to optimize workflows. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Economics, Finance, Law, or Computer Science. An MBA is highly advantageous. Must-Haves Strategic Planning, KPI/OKR Design, Process Automation, Financial Acumen, and Data Analysis. An innate drive to leverage AI and technology to replace manual effort. Extreme ownership, high urgency, executive presence, and the ability to simplify chaos. Native or entirely fluent English (written and verbal). Advantages Experience within the AWS ecosystem, FinOps, or high-growth SaaS startups. Professional background in Tier-1 management consulting. Hands-on proficiency with HubSpot and Business Intelligence (BI) tools. Our office is located at Beit Gibor Sport Tower, Ramat Gan, near Tel Aviv Savidor Central railway station. jobs.title: Senior DevOps/MLOps Ramat Gan Senior Full-time
jobs.description: Directeam ALL JOBS Senior DevOps/MLOps R&D Ramat Gan Senior Full-time Description Directeam empowers startups to scale their AWS infrastructure efficiently through our premier FinOps ecosystem. We combine our flagship automated savings engine, Sombrero Savings, with our latest innovation: a real-time, AI-powered FinOps, SRE, and cloud architecture platform designed to help engineering teams analyze, investigate, and optimize their AWS environments. As a premier AI-native AWS Partner, we go beyond simple cost management. We provide a strategic advantage that converts cloud inefficiency into business runway. Our solutions deliver significant market impact. Our AI-driven services have been widely adopted across our client base, achieving an average monthly cost reduction of over 30% and positioning us as a leader in cloud optimization. The Role We are seeking a Senior DevOps/MLOps with extensive hands-on AWS and DevOps expertise to translate cloud operational excellence into a robust production product. In this role, you will develop the backend systems and agentic workflows that analyze cloud costs, reliability, security, logs, and architectural risks. While prior GenAI experience is an advantage, we prioritize strong cloud judgment, backend engineering excellence, and the curiosity to build agentic systems from the ground up. Requirements Architect and build the agentic systems powering our FinOps, SRE, and cloud architecture solutions. Design and implement agents capable of investigating AWS environments, complex cloud data, and delivering insights. Encode deep AWS operational expertise, spanning IAM, networking, and management into agent tools, decision logic, and retrieval systems. Develop the backend platform to support production-grade agents, focusing on AWS integrations. Iteratively improve agent performance based on production feedback, analysis, and customer usage patterns. Maintain full ownership of the product lifecycle, from initial design through deployment and long-term iteration. Collaborate with product and engineering teams to transform real-world cloud challenges into dependable, automated capabilities. What we’re looking for Must have 7+ years of hands-on AWS or DevOps experience in production-scale environments. 2+ years of backend development experience, with a proven track record of building and operating production systems. Deep technical proficiency in AWS services, cloud networking, and security best practices. Strong backend engineering skills, ideally with Python and native AWS services. Experience architecting APIs, asynchronous jobs, and complex data-processing workflows. Proficiency in designing for resilience, including observability, and robust error handling. Ownership mindset with the ability to navigate and drive customer outcomes. Excellent communication skills and a collaborative approach to problem-solving. Nice to have Experience building GenAI applications, LLM workflows, RAG systems, or evaluation pipelines. Familiarity with tool calling, agent orchestration, and prompt engineering. Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), CI/CD, and Kubernetes. Background in cloud cost optimization, SRE practices, or security automation. Experience thriving in high-growth startup environments. Degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical engineering experience. Location: Beit Gibor Sport Tower, Ramat Gan (near Tel Aviv Savidor Central Station). APPLY FOR THIS JOB ALL JOBS

As a premier AI-native AWS Partner, we go beyond simple cost management. We provide a strategic advantage that converts cloud inefficiency into business runway. Our solutions deliver significant market impact. Our AI-driven services have been widely adopted across our client base, achieving an average monthly cost reduction of over 30% and positioning us as a leader in cloud optimization. We are seeking our first Head of Sales in Israel to architect and lead our commercial operations from the ground up. Reporting to the VP Revenue & Strategy, you will hold end-to-end accountability for the customer lifecycle, driving pipeline growth, overseeing account management, and shaping our go-to-market strategy. Requirements Architect and scale our end-to-end sales motion (inbound/outbound) and account management team. Design scalable sales processes and integrate AI-driven tools to enhance operational efficiency and focus on high-impact revenue activities. Recruit, coach, and mentor a high-performing team, fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous professional growth. Establish Directeam as a thought leader across the Israeli startup and AWS ecosystems, cultivating high-level relationships with technical decision-makers (CTOs, VPs of R&D). Own the full customer journey, manage critical escalations, and lead negotiations on strategic contracts (e.g., Private Pricing, EDP) in collaboration with AWS. Partner with the teams to refine our GTM strategy and integrate customer insights into our roadmap. Proven ability to integrate AI into daily workflows and build process automations to drive team efficiency and operational scale. Exceptional leadership and communication skills in both Hebrew and English, with the ability to influence and build trust at all levels. BSc in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience. MBA is a plus. Why Join Us?
